verdict.rationale: The evidence shows connectors for APIs, email, calendar, Salesforce, and a vague 'Grok Bot' cloud computer teammate, but nothing documents Grok actually driving a web browser to navigate sites or complete tasks (no browsing/computer-use agent feature is described). Multi-agent research (grok-docs-26) is about research orchestration, not website interaction, so this applicable-but-unevidenced capability is 'none'.
